_purpose: ManualDriveController with NO physical input device. input_type=stub returns an all-zero PedalSteerCommand every frame and ffb_enabled=false keeps SDL2 out of the picture entirely, so a scenario referencing this config runs headless, in CI, and alongside other processes without touching the G29 or contending for its device index. override.enabled=false pins both domains permanently MANUAL (OverrideManager.cpp:208-214), which is what makes 'ManualDrive is writing every frame' a property of the config rather than of what a driver happened to do.
